content_en: Tomorrow will be a busy day for me. I plan to get up at seven and make a healthy breakfast. After breakfast, I will go to the bank and pay a few bills. Then I need to buy some food at the supermarket. In the afternoon, I am going to meet a friend for coffee. We haven't seen each other for months. In the evening, I will stay home, cook dinner, and watch a movie. I hope everything goes well.

content_en: I want to make good use of this weekend. On Saturday morning, I am going to clean my apartment and do the laundry. In the afternoon, I plan to visit a bookstore and look for a new novel. On Sunday, I will go hiking with two friends if the weather is nice. We may have lunch outside after the walk. I also need some time to rest before Monday. A little planning will help me enjoy my weekend without feeling rushed.

content_en: This month, I want to set a new goal for myself. I have decided to exercise three times a week. I will start with a short walk and some simple exercises at home. I also want to eat more vegetables and drink enough water. My goal is not to change everything in one day. I just want to build better habits slowly. I will write down my progress every Sunday. I know it may be difficult at first, but I am ready to try.

content_en: I have always wanted to learn how to cook. Last week, I bought a beginner's cookbook and watched a few cooking videos. Yesterday, I tried to make vegetable soup for the first time. I followed the steps carefully, but I added too much salt. The soup was not perfect, but I enjoyed the process. I plan to practice every weekend and try new recipes. Learning something new takes time, so I will be patient with myself.

content_en: Recently, I have become interested in photography. I bought a small camera because I want to take better pictures. Last weekend, I went to a park and took photos of flowers, birds, and trees. At first, I found it difficult to use the camera settings. A friend gave me some useful advice and showed me a few simple tricks. I enjoyed the experience very much. I am going to practice more and take my camera on my next trip.

content_en: A few months ago, I had to make a big decision about my job. I could stay in my old position or accept a new offer from another company. I made a list of the good and bad points of each choice. I also talked with my family and asked for their advice. In the end, I decided to try the new job. I was nervous, but I felt excited too. Sometimes, making a decision is difficult, but thinking carefully can help.
content_cn: 几个月前，我不得不为自己的工作做一个重要决定。我可以留在原来的岗位，也可以接受另一家公司的新工作邀请。我列出了每个选择的优点和缺点。我还和家人谈了谈，听取他们的建议。最后，我决定尝试新工作。我有些紧张，但也感到兴奋。有时候，做决定确实很困难，但认真思考会有所帮助。

content_en: I want to change my daily routine because I often feel tired in the morning. I usually stay up late and get up too late. Starting next week, I will go to bed thirty minutes earlier. I also plan to put my phone away before bedtime. In the morning, I will open the window, drink some water, and take a short walk. These changes are small, but I hope they will help me feel better and have more energy.

content_en: Our community is going to hold a small outdoor event next Saturday. I am helping to prepare it with a few neighbors. We need to set up tables, put up signs, and prepare some simple games. I will also bring drinks and snacks for the guests. On Friday evening, we are meeting to check that everything is ready. I hope many people will come and enjoy the day. Working together makes the preparation easier and more fun.

content_en: My mother's birthday is next week, so I am planning a small party for her. I have invited ten family members and close friends. We will have the party at my parents' house on Saturday evening. I need to order a cake, buy some flowers, and prepare her favorite food. My sister is going to decorate the living room with balloons. I hope my mother will be surprised and happy. I want this day to be special for her.

content_en: I am going to invite some friends over this Friday evening. We haven't spent time together for a long time, so I want to have a relaxed night at home. I will prepare some snacks and make tea and coffee. My friend Lisa is bringing a board game, and Tom will bring some music. We can talk, play games, and enjoy the evening. I hope everyone can come. It will be a nice chance to catch up with each other.

content_en: My friend Emma had a difficult week, so I wanted to do something nice for her. I called two other friends and planned a small surprise. On Saturday afternoon, we decorated her living room with balloons and prepared her favorite food. When Emma came home, she was very surprised and happy. We sang a song and gave her a little gift. She smiled and thanked everyone. It was a simple surprise, but it made her day much better.
content_cn: 我的朋友艾玛度过了艰难的一周，所以我想为她做点好事。我给另外两个朋友打了电话，并计划了一场小惊喜。星期六下午，我们用气球装饰了她的客厅，还准备了她最喜欢的食物。艾玛回家时，非常惊讶，也很开心。我们唱了一首歌，并送给她一份小礼物。她笑着向大家道谢。这是一个简单的惊喜，却让她那一天变得愉快了许多。

content_en: Yesterday, I saw an old man carrying several heavy bags near the bus stop. He was walking slowly and looked tired. I asked if he needed help. He smiled and said yes. I carried two bags while he held the others. We walked together to his apartment building. He thanked me and wished me a nice day. I felt happy because I had made his trip easier. It reminded me that small acts of kindness can mean a lot.
content_cn: 昨天，我在公交车站附近看到一位老人提着几个沉重的袋子。他走得很慢，看起来很疲惫。我问他是否需要帮助。他微笑着说需要。我帮他提了两个袋子，他拿着剩下的袋子。我们一起走到了他的公寓楼。他向我道谢，并祝我度过愉快的一天。因为我让他的这段路轻松了一些，所以我感到很开心。这件事让我想起，小小的善举也可能意义重大。

content_en: Monday was a very busy day for me. I woke up late because my alarm did not ring. Then I missed the bus and arrived at work twenty minutes late. I also forgot an important document at home. At first, I felt upset and wanted to give up. But I took a deep breath and solved each problem one by one. By the evening, everything was under control. I learned that staying calm can help me deal with difficult situations.
content_cn: 星期一对我来说是非常忙碌的一天。因为闹钟没有响，我起晚了。接着，我错过了公交车，上班迟到了二十分钟。我还把一份重要文件忘在了家里。一开始，我感到很沮丧，甚至想放弃。但我深吸了一口气，并逐一解决每个问题。到了晚上，一切都恢复了正常。我明白了，保持冷静有助于应对困难的情况。

sentences.sentence_en: Monday was a very busy day for me.

sentences.explanation: a busy day 表示忙碌的一天；for me 表示对我而言。

sentences.sentence_cn: 因为闹钟没有响，我起晚了。
sentences.explanation: wake up 是醒来；because 引导原因从句；ring 表示铃响。

sentences.sentence_en: Then I missed the bus and arrived at work twenty minutes late.

sentences.explanation: forgot 是 forget 的过去式；at home 表示在家。

sentences.sentence_en: At first, I felt upset and wanted to give up.
sentences.sentence_cn: 一开始，我感到很沮丧，甚至想放弃。
sentences.explanation: at first 表示起初；give up 表示放弃。

sentences.sentence_en: But I took a deep breath and solved each problem one by one.
sentences.sentence_cn: 但我深吸了一口气，并逐一解决每个问题。
sentences.explanation: take a deep breath 表示深呼吸；one by one 表示一个接一个地。

sentences.sentence_en: By the evening, everything was under control.
sentences.sentence_cn: 到了晚上，一切都恢复了正常。
sentences.explanation: by the evening 表示到晚上时；under control 表示处于可控状态。

sentences.sentence_en: I learned that staying calm can help me deal with difficult situations.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我明白了，保持冷静有助于应对困难的情况。
sentences.explanation: staying calm 是动名词短语作主语；deal with 表示处理、应对。

expressions.example: I woke up late this morning.
Hurry up, or we will miss the bus.
Don't give up when things get difficult.
Take a deep breath and relax.
Let's answer the questions one by one.

questions.question: Why did the writer wake up late?
options: A. The alarm did not ring.
questions.explanation: 闹钟没有响，所以作者起晚了。

questions.question: What did the writer forget at home?
questions.explanation: 文中提到忘记了一份重要文件。

questions.question: How did the writer solve the problems?
options: A. By asking everyone to help
C. By staying calm and solving them one by one
questions.explanation: 作者深呼吸，保持冷静，逐一解决问题。

quality_check.american_english: 使用自然的美式英语表达
quality_check.chunking: 每句分块按原文顺序拼接可还原原句
quality_check.notes: A2 难度，练习描述问题、情绪和解决过程。

content_en: A few years ago, I was afraid to try new things. I often worried about making mistakes and cared too much about what other people thought. Over time, I started learning new skills and meeting different people. Some experiences were difficult, but they helped me grow. I am still learning, and I know I have a long way to go. When I look back, I feel proud of how far I have come. Every small step has made a difference.
content_cn: 几年前，我害怕尝试新事物。我经常担心犯错，也过于在意别人对我的看法。随着时间的推移，我开始学习新技能，并结识不同的人。有些经历很困难，但它们帮助我成长。我仍然在学习，也知道自己还有很长的路要走。当我回顾过去时，我为自己已经走过的路感到自豪。每一个小小的进步都带来了改变。

sentences.sentence_en: A few years ago, I was afraid to try new things.
sentences.sentence_cn: 几年前，我害怕尝试新事物。
sentences.explanation: a few years ago 表示几年前；be afraid to do 表示害怕做某事。

sentences.sentence_en: I often worried about making mistakes and cared too much about what other people thought.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我经常担心犯错，也过于在意别人对我的看法。
sentences.explanation: worry about 后接名词或动名词；what 引导宾语从句。

sentences.sentence_en: Over time, I started learning new skills and meeting different people.
sentences.sentence_cn: 随着时间的推移，我开始学习新技能，并结识不同的人。
sentences.explanation: over time 表示随着时间推移；start 后可接动名词。

sentences.sentence_en: Some experiences were difficult, but they helped me grow.
sentences.sentence_cn: 有些经历很困难，但它们帮助我成长。
sentences.explanation: help someone do something 表示帮助某人做某事。

sentences.sentence_en: I am still learning, and I know I have a long way to go.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我仍然在学习，也知道自己还有很长的路要走。

chunks.text: I have a long way to go.

sentences.explanation: still 表示仍然；have a long way to go 表示还有很长的路要走。

sentences.sentence_en: When I look back, I feel proud of how far I have come.
sentences.sentence_cn: 当我回顾过去时，我为自己已经走过的路感到自豪。
sentences.explanation: look back 表示回顾；feel proud of 表示为……感到自豪。

sentences.sentence_en: Every small step has made a difference.
sentences.sentence_cn: 每一个小小的进步都带来了改变。
sentences.explanation: has made 是现在完成时；make a difference 表示产生影响、带来改变。

expressions.example: I was afraid to speak in public.
Don't worry about small mistakes.
Over time, my English became better.
I sometimes look back on my childhood.
A little practice can make a difference.

questions.question: What was the writer afraid of a few years ago?
questions.explanation: 文章开头说明作者过去害怕尝试新事物。

questions.question: What helped the writer grow?
questions.explanation: 文中说一些困难的经历帮助作者成长。

questions.question: How does the writer feel when looking back?
questions.explanation: 作者回顾过去时，为自己走过的路感到自豪。

quality_check.american_english: 使用自然的美式英语表达
quality_check.chunking: 每句分块按原文顺序拼接可还原原句
quality_check.notes: A2 难度，练习描述过去、成长经历和个人感受。

content_en: Today, I am going to use English in several real-life situations. First, I will book a hotel room and ask about the price. Then I will talk to a new coworker and introduce myself. If I have a problem, I will explain it clearly and ask for help. I can also talk about my last vacation and my plans for next weekend. I may not speak perfectly, but I will keep trying. The most important thing is to communicate with confidence.
content_cn: 今天，我打算在几种真实生活场景中使用英语。首先，我会预订一个酒店房间，并询问价格。然后，我会和一位新同事交谈并介绍自己。如果遇到问题，我会清楚地说明情况并寻求帮助。我还可以谈论上一次假期以及下周末的计划。我可能说得不够完美，但我会继续尝试。最重要的是有信心地进行交流。

sentences.sentence_en: Today, I am going to use English in several real-life situations.
sentences.sentence_cn: 今天，我打算在几种真实生活场景中使用英语。

chunks.text: I am going to use English

chunks.meaning: 在几种现实生活的情境中。

sentences.explanation: be going to 表示计划或打算；real-life situations 表示现实生活场景。

sentences.sentence_en: First, I will book a hotel room and ask about the price.
sentences.sentence_cn: 首先，我会预订一个酒店房间，并询问价格。

chunks.text: I will book a hotel room
chunks.meaning: 我会预订一间酒店房间

sentences.explanation: will 表示将来的行动；ask about 表示询问有关……的信息。

sentences.sentence_en: Then I will talk to a new coworker and introduce myself.
sentences.sentence_cn: 然后，我会和一位新同事交谈并介绍自己。

chunks.text: I will talk to a new coworker
chunks.meaning: 我会和一位新同事聊聊

sentences.explanation: talk to someone 表示与某人交谈；introduce myself 表示自我介绍。

sentences.sentence_en: If I have a problem, I will explain it clearly and ask for help.
sentences.sentence_cn: 如果遇到问题，我会清楚地说明情况并寻求帮助。
sentences.explanation: 这是第一条件句，if 从句用一般现在时，主句用 will。

sentences.sentence_en: I can also talk about my last vacation and my plans for next weekend.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我还可以谈论上一次假期以及下周末的计划。

chunks.text: and my plans for next weekend.

sentences.explanation: can 表示能力；talk about 表示谈论某个话题。

sentences.sentence_en: I may not speak perfectly, but I will keep trying.
sentences.sentence_cn: 我可能说得不够完美，但我会继续尝试。
sentences.explanation: may 表示可能；keep doing something 表示继续做某事。

sentences.sentence_en: The most important thing is to communicate with confidence.
sentences.sentence_cn: 最重要的是有信心地进行交流。
sentences.explanation: the most important 表示最重要的；with confidence 表示有信心地。

expressions.example: I'd like to book a hotel room for two nights.
Can I ask about the price?
Let me introduce myself. My name is Alex.
Don't be afraid to ask for help.
Keep trying, and you will improve.

questions.question: What will the writer do first?
questions.explanation: 文章第二句说首先要预订酒店房间。

questions.question: What will the writer do if there is a problem?
options: B. Explain it and ask for help
questions.explanation: 作者会清楚说明问题并寻求帮助。

questions.question: What does the writer think is most important?
questions.explanation: 最后一句强调最重要的是有信心地交流。
